annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/987 of 27 April 2018 amending and correcting Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/655 with regard to monitoring of gaseous pollutant emissions from in-service internal combustion engines installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/987 of 27 April 2018 amending and correcting Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/655 with regard to monitoring of gaseous pollutant emissions from in-service internal combustion engines installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 182
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission delegated regulation amending and correcting Delegated Regulation 2017/655 on in-service monitoring of gaseous pollutant emissions from internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery. It adjusts testing durations, deadlines, calculation rules and transitional type-approval provisions. Not related to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Inserts Article 3a transitional provisions allowing type-approvals until 31 Dec 2018 and market placement until 30 June 2019 under the earlier version.
Reduces accumulated service requirements for NRE-v-5 engines and sets test-result submission deadlines (2022, 2024).
Clarifies reference work and CO2 mass sources and rounding rules for emissions calculations.
Corrects errors in equations, responsibilities and units in the Annex and appendices.
Enters into force on the twentieth day after publication; binding and directly applicable.
